bdf.distributions.GammaABLambdaPoisson

class bdf.distributions.GammaABLambdaPoisson(params)[source]

Bases: BDFDistribution[GammaABLambdaPoissonParams]

Poisson-Gamma conjugate model with shape-rate parameterization.

Usage: dist="GammaABLambdaPoisson"

Model:

  • Prior: \(\lambda \sim \text{Gamma}(\alpha, \beta)\)

  • Likelihood: \(y \mid \lambda \sim \text{Poisson}(\lambda)\)

  • Posterior: \(\lambda \mid y \sim \text{Gamma}(\alpha + \sum y_i, \beta + n)\)

  • Posterior Predictive: \(y_\text{new} \mid y \sim \text{NegBin}(\alpha_\text{post}, \beta_\text{post}/(1+\beta_\text{post}))\)

Parameters:

  • alpha_lambda (float, default=1.0) – Shape parameter \(\alpha\) of the Gamma prior on rate \(\lambda\).

  • beta_lambda (float, default=1.0) – Rate parameter \(\beta\) of the Gamma prior on rate \(\lambda\).

  • raise_on_non_integer (bool, default=True) – If True, raises an error when non-integer data is provided.
